eval: (() => { const g = game, L = g.terrain.lakes, out = []; L.near(0, 0, 700, out); const l = out.sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x, a.z) - Math.hypot(b.x, b.z))[0]; window.__lake = l; const p = g.player; p.position.set(l.x + l.r + 60, 0, l.z); p.position.y = g.terrain.heightAt(p.position.x, p.position.z); p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0); g.chunks.warmup(p.position); g.audio.unlock(); return { lago: [+l.x.toFixed(0), +l.z.toFixed(0)], raio: +l.r.toFixed(0) }; })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, l = window.__lake, V = g.player.position.constructor; const res = {}; for (const [nome, K] of [['javali', g.boars], ['veado', g.deer]]) { for (let i = K.active.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) K.release(i); K.spawnTimer = 1e9; const a = K.spawn(new V(l.x + l.r + 45, 0, l.z + 20), 0, 1, 0); a.thirst = 0; let bebeu = 0, chegou = null, prof = null, olhando = null; for (let i = 0; i < 4500; i++) { K.update(1 / 30); if (a.state === 'drink') { if (!bebeu) { chegou = +Math.round(i / 30); const dx = l.x - a.pos.x, dz = l.z - a.pos.z; prof = +(Math.hypot(dx, dz) - l.r).toFixed(1); olhando = +Math.abs(((Math.atan2(dx, dz) - a.yaw + Math.PI * 3) % (Math.PI * 2)) - Math.PI).toFixed(2); } bebeu++; } } res[nome] = { segundosAteBeber: chegou, distanciaDaAgua: prof, erroDeDirecaoRad: olhando, quadrosBebendo: bebeu, estadoFinal: a.state, sede: +a.thirst.toFixed(0) }; } return res; })()
